articles.title: Trump confirms he asked Fifa boss for review of US striker's ban
articles.description: The US president says Fifa "made the right decision" to suspend Folarin Balogun's one-match ban, adding that otherwise, it would have left a "big stain" on the World Cup.

articles.title: Buckingham Palace says Prince Harry will not stay there despite his team announcing he would
articles.description: Royal sources say the Duke of Sussex had not responded to the offer of accommodation at a Royal residence by the deadline last week.

articles.title: Britain's Arthur Fery reaches Wimbledon quarter-finals in history-making match
articles.description: Arthur Fery's outstanding Wimbledon run continues as he beats Grigor Dimitrov in five thrilling sets to become the first British wildcard to reach a Grand Slam quarter-final.

articles.title: Consultants in England vote in favour of NHS strikes
articles.description: The senior doctors in England now have a mandate for strike action over the next 12 months.
